name: A new era of cybersecurity – National strategy for cybersecurity 2025–2029
description: A new era of cybersecurity – National strategy for cybersecurity 2025–2029 (Skr. 2024/25:121, adopted March 13, 2025). Sweden's national cybersecurity strategy coordinated with the National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC / FRA) setting priorities across systematic security management, skills, incident resilience, and active cyber defense.
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Regeringskansliet / Sveriges regering (regeringen.se) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Regeringskansliet / Sveriges regering (regeringen.se).
